sign_off.notes: Covered the drawer categories, folder file management, text viewer open, edit, save and rotate, select all/deselect all, and the new-folder dialog. One bug was confirmed and logged: Rename from the Images category page does nothing. Three reports were rejected as not reproducible by the developer: duplicate folder name in the New Folder dialog, the Jan 1, 1970 date in the editor Details dialog, and the "0 folders and 0 files" count on Recent files. I saw all three twice or more. Not tested: large text files (chunked reading), the batch invert-selection entry, which I couldn't find in the overflow menu, and the other categories' per-item actions.
